summary: Public façade for the mountainash typed error hierarchy, modelled on polars.exceptions. It defines nothing itself; it re-exports error classes from core, conform, relations, dag, dtypes, typespec, expressions.membership and validation so users have one import home.
key_classes: MountainashError — root marker class for every mountainash-raised typed error (defined in core/errors.py)
extension_points: New typed errors are defined in their owning module's errors.py and then re-exported here and in __all__
Hybrid hierarchy: subclass MountainashError plus a builtin (ValueError/TypeError) for builtin-compatible catches
lifecycle_notes: Recent additions track new modules: cdee565d (descriptor/location errors), 22cc3292 (schema resolution errors).
Governed by principle typed-error-hierarchy (ADOPTED, boy-scout migration ratchet).
documentation_hooks: Error handling guide: catching MountainashError vs specific errors
Error catalogue grouped by owning module
Contributor note on adding a new error
risks: Façade must be kept in sync by hand; a new error absent from this file is not reachable from the canonical import home (tests/test_exceptions_facade.py guards this).
Only MountainashError is exported from the package root; all others live here.

evidence.detail: imports and __all__ re-export errors from eight modules
